messages:
lee: Heads-up: small RFC follow-up idea for onboard pipeline — add a fast 'mini-gate' run during model ingest that focuses on ABI, KV continuity, and a tiny perf check. think <2m so infra can auto-accept or flag.

anya: yes please. too many silent breakages make it to staging. what checks exactly?

lee: proposal:
- ABI fingerprint (operator layout + quant params hash)
- proto schema validation (shapes, optional->required diffs)
- kv continuity replay (split prompt pieces, ensure cache state resumes)
- perf microprobe (batch=1, seq lenses 16/128, 50 samples)
- semantic quick (50 golden prompts, ann-approx on embeddings)

 todd: for ABI fingerprint, should we include packing endian/order? onnx export sometimes changes op order. hash needs to be stable across equivalent graphs.

anya: good call. make hash canonicalize graph (sort nodes, normalize names) before hashing.

lee: failure modes: AUTO_REJECT (schema/ABI mismatch), REVIEW (kv/perf/drift), WARN (mild perf blips). map to numeric codes so the console can route.

ops-bot: pipeline artifact: ci://handoff/1767779999/mini-gate.tar.gz :white_check_mark:

 todd: small implementation notes: keep runner side-effect free, run in isolated container with pinned CUDA, and produce a single JSON diagnostics blob with traces + short hints.

anya: owners? i can build the golden prompt packs and the ann-lite index. todd you can own ABI+perf. lee you can wire CI and failure codes.

lee: sounds good. i'll open eng-ml/mini-handoff repo and add a short runbook template. sample local use:
```
./mini_handoff --model rwd-lite-1 --node staging-02 --seed 7 --quick
```

 todd: will add quant-aware comparators (edit-distance or top-k overlap) for token checks.

anya: doc note: include guidance on when to escalate to eng-ml vs runtime infra. i'll draft a one-pager.

lee: ok closing with owners: lee (CI + repo), todd (abi + perf), anya (goldens + doc). thanks all :thumbsup:
